name: web-agents
description: Agents in the browser with WebMCP and Chrome Prompt API.

scripts.cdp:canary: if pgrep -f 'web-agents-[c]anary' >/dev/null; then if curl -sf -m 2 127.0.0.1:$npm_package_config_cdp_canary_port/json/version >/dev/null; then echo "Canary already running on :$npm_package_config_cdp_canary_port"; else echo "a web-agents Canary is running, but not on :$npm_package_config_cdp_canary_port. Quit it (pkill -f web-agents-canary) and run this again." >&2; exit 1; fi; else open -na 'Google Chrome Canary' --args --remote-debugging-port=$npm_package_config_cdp_canary_port --remote-allow-origins='*' --user-data-dir=$HOME/.cache/web-agents-canary --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check http://127.0.0.1:4610/public/; fi
scripts.check: npm run lint:check && npm run pretty:check
scripts.format: npm run lint:fix && npm run pretty:fix
